# Tone.js

`Tone-15.1.22.js` is the unmodified browser distribution from
https://unpkg.com/tone@15.1.22/build/Tone.js (Tone.js 15.1.22).
Its MIT license is in `Tone-LICENSE.md`. No samples are included.

The single local script is 345,500 bytes (79,660 bytes with gzip). It needs no
build, package install, or third-party runtime request. Source:
https://github.com/Tonejs/Tone.js/tree/15.1.22.
